assertion.en: Tendons connect bone to bone and allow joint movement.

reason.en: Tendons are made of tough connective tissue that transmits force from muscle to bone.

a.en: The assertion is false: tendons connect muscle to bone. It is ligaments that connect bone to bone.

b.en: The assertion is false, so this cannot be right. Tendons connect muscle to bone, not bone to bone.

c.en: It is the other way round. The reason is true, but the assertion is false: ligaments, not tendons, connect bone to bone.

d.en: Correct. Tendons connect muscle to bone, so the assertion is false. The reason is true: a tendon is tough connective tissue that passes the pull of a muscle to a bone.

explanation.en: Tendons connect muscles to bones, and ligaments connect bones to bones. So the assertion mixes up the two and is false. The reason is a true description of a tendon: tough connective tissue that transmits force from muscle to bone.
